deficiencies.description: The developmental stage 'adolescence' was changed to the biological process 'differentiation'.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: because obviously during adolescence and maturation, this occurs from infancy to adulthood.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: because differentiation and maturation also occur from infancy to adulthood.
deficiencies.caseForForbidden: The rewrite replaces 'adolescence', a specific developmental period, with 'differentiation', which changes a technical term and alters the meaning of the developmental timeline.
deficiencies.caseForAllowed: The writer may have understood 'this occurs' to refer to the process of differentiation, but replacing 'adolescence' entirely changes the stated conditions.

considerations.sourcePassage: during embryogenesis, during the time that you were born.
considerations.reason: The phrase 'during the time that you were born' is a conversational false start or clarification immediately following 'embryogenesis', and omitting it is an allowed removal of disfluency.

considerations.sourcePassage: And you can see here now the cells are all of different shapes and sizes.
considerations.reason: The rewrite renders 'here now' as 'In the image of the invasive tissue', which is explicitly confirmed by the surrounding context where the cells have invaded the stroma.

considerations.sourcePassage: provides a signaling and basis for their adherence to this layer.
considerations.reason: 'signaling and basis' was smoothed to 'signalling basis' to correct a spoken disfluency without changing the underlying meaning.

considerations.sourcePassage: which would be here into the invading stroma.
considerations.reason: Changing 'invading stroma' to 'invaded stroma' corrects a slip of the tongue, as the surrounding text establishes that the cancer cells are invading into the stroma.
